title: Liberty Latin America Announces Executive Team Changes

body_markdown:
# Liberty Latin America Announces Executive Team Changes


- Guillermo Ponce appointed as interim General Manager of Cable & Wireless Panama
- Rocio Lorenzo will be leaving the company to join Telenet as CEO in Belgium


**Denver, Colorado** - October 14, 2026:[Liberty Latin America Ltd](http://www.lla.com/) . (“Liberty Latin America” or “LLA”) (NASDAQ: LILA and LILAK, OTC Link: LILAB) today announced it has made changes to its Executive Team.


Guillermo Ponce been appointed SVP, interim General Manager of Cable & Wireless Panama replacing Rocio Lorenzo who will be leaving the company to join Telenet as CEO in Belgium.


Balan Nair, President and CEO of Liberty Latin America, said, “Rocio has made a significant and lasting impact on our business, and I want to thank her for her dedication, commitment, and many contributions to Liberty Latin America. She has also built a strong team and a solid foundation in Panama that Guillermo will build from. I have tremendous confidence in Guillermo’s leadership, experience, and ability to continue our momentum, execute against our strategy, and create long-term value for our customers, employees, and shareholders.”


[Read Full Release Here](https://lla.com/sites/default/files/2026-10/Liberty%20Latin%20America%20Announces%20Executive%20Team%20Changes.pdf)
